title: China’s fourth aircraft carrier, bigger than others and nuclear-powered, nears completion
big: 59 new stories. The new stories are led by budget and policy; the top five are about drones, capital markets, allies, budget and policy, ships.

stories.h: China’s fourth aircraft carrier, bigger than others and nuclear-powered, nears completion
stories.what: NEW TAIPEI CITY, Taiwan — China's fourth aircraft carrier, a gigantic vessel known so far as just Type 004, will come out as early as next year bigger than its predecessors and with nuclear power that can launch planes faster than usual in case of any…
stories.you: A nuclear carrier lets China launch aircraft faster than its earlier hulls. The buy that follows is the air wing and the escorts.

stories.h: U.S. Commits $2B Defense Loan for Philippine Military, Luzon Strait Development
stories.what: MANILA, Philippines — The U.S. pledged to grant a $2 billion foreign military financing loan package for Manila's military modernization efforts and the development of an airport in the Luzon Strait.
stories.you: Financing for Luzon Strait sites sets up US-built buys for the Philippine military.

stories.h: Amentum Reports $13.8B in FY2026 Revenue, $48.3B Backlog
stories.what: Amentum secured $15 billion in net bookings, including major NGA, Navy, Army and international nuclear program awards.
stories.you: Amentum reported $13.8B of revenue and a $48.3B backlog, including work for the Navy, the Army and NGA. That is the order book, not a new program.

stories.h: $16 billion propulsion mega-contract posted in error, Air Force says
stories.what: The Air Force is planning to award the $16.1 billion Advanced Propulsion Acquisition Contract, but has not yet done so, the service told Breaking Defense.
stories.you: The Air Force says the $16B contract was posted in error and is not awarded. There is no buy until it is reposted.

stories.what: WASHINGTON — BlackSky Technology announced it acquired geospatial data firm EpochGeo, a move to expand its slate of real-time intelligence tools as defense customers seek deeper analysis and data fusion capabilities.
stories.you: BlackSky Technology's purchase of EpochGeo changes who owns that tool. It is an ownership change, not a new program of record.

watch.h: Stopgap funding expires: FY27 appropriations or another CR
watch.why: December 11. Decides whether DAWG's $54.6B and Golden Dome's growth become real money.

idea.h: Synthetic data and test & evaluation for autonomy
idea.why: Simulation and synthetic sensor data to train and certify autonomy when GPS is denied and radios are jammed. New autonomy policy (the June 2026 memo, CSIS definitions) means systems need verification evidence, and the new command gets test powers.
